title: Preventing Chronic Kidney Disease
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to preventing chronic kidney disease.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical guidelines and randomized controlled trials supports blood pressure and diabetes management in CKD prevention. Moderate evidence supports the role of lifestyle interventions such as diet and exercise. Emerging evidence exists for newer medications like SGLT2 inhibitors. Limitations include variability in individual response and gaps in screening implementation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
